headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from international football
summary: The 39-year-old legend announces his departure from the Argentina national team via an emotional Instagram post.
details: Lionel Messi, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, has officially announced his retirement from international football after leading Argentina to two consecutive World Cup finals.
In an emotional letter posted on Instagram on Monday, the 39-year-old captain stated that it is the right time to step away from the national team.
Messi revealed that he wrote the farewell message two days after Argentina's defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final at New York's MetLife Stadium on July 19.
He expressed that while the decision brings deep pain to his soul, he feels he has given everything he possibly could to the iconic blue-and-white jersey.
The legend noted that he fought with the same dedication during both the trophy-laden recent years and the difficult periods of failure in the past.
Messi also highlighted the emergence of talented young players in the squad, stating they now deserve the opportunity to lead the team.
He expressed profound gratitude to his family, coaching staff, teammates, and millions of fans who supported him over the last two decades.
The legendary captain concluded by saying he will now continue to support the team as an ordinary fan from the stands.
caption:
The most magical chapter in football history comes to an end. Lionel Messi has officially retired from international football.

Lionel Messi, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, has officially announced his retirement from international football after leading Argentina to two consecutive World Cup finals.

In an emotional letter posted on Instagram on Monday, the 39-year-old captain stated that it is the right time to step away from the national team.

Messi revealed that he wrote the farewell message two days after Argentina's defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final at New York's MetLife Stadium on July 19.

He expressed that while the decision brings deep pain to his soul, he feels he has given everything he possibly could to the iconic blue-and-white jersey.

The legend noted that he fought with the same dedication during both the trophy-laden recent years and the difficult periods of failure in the past.

Messi also highlighted the emergence of talented young players in the squad, stating they now deserve the opportunity to lead the team.

He expressed profound gratitude to his family, coaching staff, teammates, and millions of fans who supported him over the last two decades.

The legendary captain concluded by saying he will now continue to support the team as an ordinary fan from the stands.

headline_marked: Tk 105,580 crore cost: [[Govt approves new pay scale]] for public servants
headline: Tk 105,580 crore cost: Govt approves new pay scale for public servants
summary: The National Pay Scale 2026 will be implemented in four phases to manage budget pressure and inflation, benefiting 24 lakh employees and 9.25 lakh pensioners.
details: The government has approved the National Pay Scale 2026, which will be implemented in four phases over two fiscal years to ease pressure on the national budget and contain inflation.
Basic salaries will be rolled out in three phases between July 1, 2026, and July 1, 2027, while all allowances under the new structure will take effect from January 1, 2028.
Once fully implemented, the new pay scale will benefit approximately 24 lakh military and civilian employees, as well as about 925,000 pensioners and other eligible beneficiaries.
The revised structure is estimated to require an additional annual expenditure of Tk 105,580 crore, with funds allocated under the medium-term budget framework.
In a first-time initiative, the government is introducing a monthly allowance of Tk 3,000 for children with special needs of public servants.
Additionally, the mobile phone allowance, previously limited to Grade 5 employees, will now be extended to employees of all grades.
caption:
A massive Tk 105,580 crore annual boost for public servants! The government has approved a new phased pay scale.

The government has approved the National Pay Scale 2026, which will be implemented in four phases over two fiscal years to ease pressure on the national budget and contain inflation.

Basic salaries will be rolled out in three phases between July 1, 2026, and July 1, 2027, while all allowances under the new structure will take effect from January 1, 2028.

Once fully implemented, the new pay scale will benefit approximately 24 lakh military and civilian employees, as well as about 925,000 pensioners and other eligible beneficiaries.

The revised structure is estimated to require an additional annual expenditure of Tk 105,580 crore, with funds allocated under the medium-term budget framework.

In a first-time initiative, the government is introducing a monthly allowance of Tk 3,000 for children with special needs of public servants.

Additionally, the mobile phone allowance, previously limited to Grade 5 employees, will now be extended to employees of all grades.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune
